result.question: Why do Arameans think Israel hired allies?

readings.answer: Because they heard the sound of chariots, horses, and a great army
readings.support: hear the sound of chariots, horses, and a great army

readings.answer: Because the Lord caused them to hear such sounds
readings.support: For the Lord had caused the Arameans to hear the sound

assessments.reason: The passage says they “heard the sound of chariots, horses, and a great army,” which led them to think Israel had hired allies; this matches the key’s reason.

The text explicitly states “the Lord had caused the Arameans to hear” those sounds, “so that they said…”; attributing their belief to the Lord causing the hearing is a one-step-up causal statement still grounded in the verse.
